title: Load account dashboard data for an authenticated session
description: Ensures an authenticated student can open the account page and see profile and progress data rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation entry to the account dashboard
Verify account profile and progress sections are displayed

title: View a saved essay result from the results page
description: Ensures an authenticated student can create an essay correction and open its detailed results page with the result content displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation entry to the essay correction feature
Generate an essay theme
Fill a sufficiently long essay text into the essay input
Submit the essay for correction
Wait for the correction result to be available
Open the detailed results view for the generated correction
Verify a detailed essay correction result is displayed with scores and feedback

title: Browse community threads for a topic
description: A visitor can open the community area, select a topic, and see a list of posts with any available threaded comments displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the community page
Select a topic to view its threads
Verify a list of posts is displayed for the selected topic
Verify threaded comments are displayed for posts that have comments

title: Create a new community post
description: An authenticated user can create a new post and then see it appear in the topic thread list.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click to open the community page
Select a topic to post in
Fill a valid post content into the new post field
Submit the new post
Verify the newly created post appears in the thread list

title: Generate quiz questions by discipline
description: Ensures a visitor can select a discipline and receive a set of quiz questions with answer options.

steps.description: Navigate to /questoes
Select a valid discipline in the discipline selector
Generate quiz questions
Verify multiple quiz questions are displayed with answer options

title: Submit quiz answers and receive scoring and explanations
description: Ensures a visitor can answer the quiz and see scored results with explanations.

steps.description: Navigate to /questoes
Select a valid discipline in the discipline selector
Generate quiz questions
Select one answer option for each question
Submit the quiz answers
Verify quiz scoring results are displayed with explanations

title: Comment on a community post
description: An authenticated user can add a comment to an existing post and then see the comment appear under that post.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click to open the community page
Select a topic to view its threads
Open the details of a post to view its comments
Fill a valid comment into the comment field
Submit the comment
Verify the new comment appears under the post

title: Authenticated quiz submission updates account stats
description: Ensures a logged-in student can complete a quiz and then see updated performance stats on the account dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation entry to the quiz feature
Select a valid discipline in the discipline selector
Generate quiz questions
Select one answer option for each question
Submit the quiz answers
Click the navigation entry to the account dashboard
Verify the dashboard performance statistics reflect a recorded quiz attempt

title: Access homepage and navigate to a core section
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor can load the homepage and use navigation to reach another section of the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a link to go to the essay section
Verify the essay page is displayed

title: Edit and save account profile information
description: Ensures an authenticated student can update their account profile via the edit page and see the updated info reflected afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /conta/editar
Fill a new display name into the name field
Save the account changes
Click the navigation entry to the account dashboard
Verify the updated display name is shown on the account dashboard

title: Start a donation checkout from the donation page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can start the donation checkout flow from the donation page and is taken to the checkout initiation step without errors.

steps.description: Navigate to /doacao
Select a preset donation amount
Submit the donation checkout
Verify the user is redirected away from the donation page into the checkout flow

title: Like count updates when liking a post
description: A visitor can like a post and see the like count update for that post in the thread list.

steps.description: Navigate to the community page
Select a topic to view its threads
Note the current like count for a visible post
Click the like control for that post
Verify the like count for the post updates

title: Browse news list with tag filtering and pagination
description: A visitor can filter news by a tag and navigate pages while continuing to see a list of articles.

steps.description: Navigate to the news page
Select a tag filter for the news list
Scroll to the pagination controls
Navigate to the next page of results
Verify a list of news articles is displayed for the selected tag on the new page

title: Start a donation checkout with a custom amount
description: This test verifies that a visitor can enter a custom donation amount and successfully start the checkout flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /doacao
Fill a valid custom donation amount into the amount field
Submit the donation checkout
Verify the user is redirected away from the donation page into the checkout flow

title: Prevent access to another user's essay result
description: Ensures a student cannot view an essay result that belongs to a different user and is shown an access denied state.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation entry to the essay correction feature
Generate an essay theme
Fill a sufficiently long essay text into the essay input
Submit the essay for correction
Wait for the correction result to be available
Log out
Navigate to /login
Fill a different valid user email into the email field
Fill a different valid user password into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to the previously created essay result URL in the same browser tab
Verify an access denied state is displayed for the essay result

title: Search news and open an article
description: A visitor can search for a keyword, see search results, and open an article page successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to the news search page
Fill a valid keyword into the search field
Submit the search
Open one article from the search results
Verify the article page displays the article content

title: Real-time community feed updates while viewing threads
description: A visitor can enable real-time updates and sees the feed update when a new post is created from another action within the same session.

steps.description: Navigate to the community page
Select a topic to view its threads
Enable real-time updates on the thread view if a control is available
Open a second community view within the same page context if the UI supports it
Create a new post from that second view if available, otherwise create a post using the same view’s new post form
Verify the thread list updates without a full page reload to include the new activity

title: Recalculate account statistics from the dashboard
description: Ensures an authenticated student can trigger statistics recalculation and see refreshed charts or stats displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Navigate to /conta
Trigger a statistics recalculation
Verify refreshed performance statistics or charts are displayed

title: Navigate from homepage to authentication entry point
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor can reach the login page from the homepage navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a link to go to the login page
Verify the login page is displayed

title: Admin maintenance and featured update endpoints are not exposed as navigable UI pages
description: This test verifies that a visitor cannot access admin maintenance tools through normal site navigation UI.

steps.description: Navigate to /sobre
Scroll through the page content
Verify no admin maintenance controls are present in the UI

title: Admin imports news into the system
description: An authenticated admin can import news and sees a confirmation that articles were imported or updated.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to the news admin page
Fill valid import source configuration into the import form
Submit the import request
Verify an import success confirmation is visible

description: Verifies an anonymous visitor can reach the registration page from the homepage navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a link to go to the registration page
Verify the registration page is displayed

steps.description: Navigate to /sobre
Verify the About page content is displayed

title: Quiz generation requires selecting a discipline

Verify a discipline selection validation message is displayed

title: View donation success page after returning from checkout

title: Explore feature overview from homepage
description: Verifies an anonymous visitor can scroll through the homepage and see the platform feature overview sections.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the feature overview section

title: Open Terms of Service page

title: Donation page shows available donation options

Verify an option to proceed to checkout is available

steps.description: Navigate to /
